integrity.method: exhaustive finite-chain computations with exact integer Smith and two independent field reductions

scientific_limitations: The theorem is about the explicit eleven-vertex quadratic-residue tournament and its cyclic-triple-count filtration, not other Paley tournaments.
Persistent barcodes are proved over F_2 and F_3; integral results are pointwise homology, not an integral barcode.
No homotopy classification of the full intermediate filtration is asserted.
An equivalent unindexed literature calculation remains possible.
title: Reentrant integral torsion and complete motif persistence of the Paley-eleven tournaplex
